What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[General Hux]]: left, the image of [[General Hux]] (holotable commit 022435b); right, the image of [[General Hux (Errata)]] (holotable commit 227990e). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/generalhux.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/227990e702a46e7c3e18bba9253aa3cf49e0bf47/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/generalhux.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
